name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $85.7 on 24 Nov, 25% lower over a month; Hormuz flows reduced but no new 2 mb/d outage confirmed
state: Brent was near $85.7 early on 24 Nov, 6.8% lower on the week and 25% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices fell to a three-month low on 23 Nov on hopes for diplomacy, while Kpler data show Hormuz crude flows averaged about 9.5m barrels a day in the 10 days to 19 Nov, against 12.2m in October (Trading Economics). No new outage above 2 mb/d is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Fuel prices tend to follow crude with a lag of a few weeks. Supply through Hormuz remains at risk while attacks on shipping continue.

sources.title: Trading Economics — Brent crude oil news

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
